questions.question_text: I am the player who scored the first goal in UEFA EURO final tournament history, finding the net for the Soviet Union against Yugoslavia in the 1960 final. Who am I?
questions.explanation: Milan Galić scored the opening goal of the 1960 final tournament, in the final against Yugoslavia.

questions.question_text: I am the player who scored the 900th goal in UEFA EURO final tournament history, netting for Austria against the Netherlands in 2024. Who am I?
questions.explanation: Romano Schmid scored the 900th EURO final tournament goal in Austria's 3–2 win over the Netherlands in June 2024.

questions.question_text: I am the player who scored the first goal in UEFA EURO final tournament history, in the 1960 semi-final between France and Yugoslavia. Who am I?
questions.explanation: François Heutte scored the first goal in EURO final tournament history during France's 1960 semi-final against Yugoslavia.

questions.question_text: I am the player who scored the winning goal in the 1960 European Nations' Cup final, giving the Soviet Union the inaugural title. Who am I?
questions.explanation: Viktor Ponedelnik scored the extra-time winner as the Soviet Union beat Yugoslavia 2–1 in the inaugural final.
